setting.coordinate: z_k=omega^k for a primitive n-th root omega
setting.decoder: R=A/B with B nonzero on all z_k

theorem.lower_bound_reason: A-B has every even z_k as a root
theorem.matching_construction: R=(O-E)/(O+E), with E and O the even and odd root products

closed_classes: low-degree rational interpolation of exact canonical parity
remaining_primitive: compute the ratio of even/odd half-orbit products or an equivalent object without materializing n/2 factors
